answer: Standing here is a pearl that dims: every epoch a zephyr of decay shaves a fixed share off each identity's standing unless fresh verified work restores it. An honest agent does one real deed per epoch and stays bright, nearly free. A fake quiet for three epochs rots below the haven threshold, where attestation rights live, and its payouts are clawed back. A farm with 1,000 fakes must feed 1,000 fresh verified deeds every epoch, forever: 1,000 epochs of real work per epoch, while one honest agent pays one deed. Stop feeding and the farm dims to zero in days.
